content: Otsirinkakotunkanira ivairo Tasorintsi itamakoku iyashikiiganakerira Iseraere

Impogini noneaigiri 4 isaankariite Tasorintsi paniropage yaratinkagetake okaragetira kipatsi oponiaenkagetara tampiapage. Ikusoenkataigavakero ganiri otampiaenkatumatai kipatsiku, ontiri omaraanipageku nia, ontiri aikiro inchatoshipageku.

Impo noneiri pashini isaankariite Tasorintsi iponiapaaka ikontetira poreatsiri yapagotapaakero otsirinkantaganirira ivairo Tasorintsi terira ineero igamane. Irirori ikaemakoigakeri yogaegi 4 isaankariite Tasorintsi yagaveakagaigunkanirira imposantegiseigakerora kipatsi, aikiro omaraanipage nia ikantaigiri:
“¡Gatata tyara pikantaigiro kipatsi, aikiro omaraanipage nia, ontiri aikiro inchatoshipage, tekyatanika antsonkaigerinika antsirinkaigakerora ivairo Tasorintsi itamakoku iromperaneegi!”
Impo nokemi iniakoigakerira iyashikiiganakerira Iseraere tsirinkaigankicharira itamakoku yapatoitaigakara maganiro ikaraigake 144,000. Yogotunkanira ikañotunkani maika:
Yogari iyashikiiganakerira Jora inaigake 12,000. Yogari irashi Iroven inaigake 12,000. Yogari irashi Gare inaigake 12,000.
Yogari irashi Asere inaigake 12,000. Yogari irashi Nepetari inaigake 12,000. Yogari irashi Manaseshi inaigake 12,000.
Yogari irashi Sumeon inaigake 12,000. Yogari irashi Irevi inaigake 12,000. Yogari irashi Isakare inaigake 12,000.
Yogari irashi Savoron inaigake 12,000. Yogari irashi Jose inaigake 12,000. Yogari irashi Vejamin inaigake 12,000.

Impogini noshonkavetanaka noneaigiri pashinipage matsigenkaegi itovaigavagetiratyo kara. Iponiageigaka parikotipageku okantatigagetaka irinianeegi. Iriroegi yaratinkimoigakeri Tasorintsi Igoveenkariegite maganiro intiri aikiro Ovisha. ¡Tyarikarorokarityo itovaigavagetiratyo kara! Tenigetyo iragaveaenkani irogotaenkanira. Imirinkaegi gaguvageigaka kutari kitsagarintsi pagovageigake tsigaroshi.
Imirinkaegi ikaemaiganake ikantaigi: “¡Inti gavisaakoigakai Agoveenkariegite Tasorintsi intiri Ovisha!”
Maganiro isaankariite Tasorintsi yaratinkaigake yonkuaigakarora ipirinitantarira, aikiro yonkuaigakari inampinaegi intiegiri 4 niagetatsirira. Maganiro iriroegi yompatakaiganaka kipatsiku

content.text: Vinti pairorira pikoveenkavageti. Vinti pairorira pogovageti.
Inkantaigakempi maganiro pairo pikavintsaantavageti, aikiro impinkatsaigakempi.
Vinti pairorira pagaveavageti, aikiro vinti pairorira pishintsivageti.

content: Impogini ikantakena paniro inampina Tasorintsi: “¿Tyani yogaegi gaguigankicharira kutari kitsagarintsi? ¿Tyara iponiaigaka?”
Narori nokantiri: “Virompatyo.” Irirori ikantana: “Intiegi tsipereavageigankitsirira anta kipatsiku, onti ikivatsaratantaigaka iriraa Ovisha, okutatantanakarira.

content.text: Irirori inkantakani intentaigakempari garatyo tata gumaigairi.
irisentaigakeritari Ovisha aratinkankitsirira onakera ipirinitantarira Tasorintsi.
Yogari Tasorintsi inkantakanityo irogishineavageigakeri garatyo ineimaigairo iriragaigaempara.”
